what: Host allocation of every rented pod of the two cloud studies (v4, v5), as returned by the provider's pod API (RunPod v2 get-pod / list-pods, field gpu.{count,id,memory,vcpuCount}) when each pod was read during the runs. Per the API schema, gpu.memory is the allocated host system RAM in GB and gpu.vcpuCount the allocated vCPU count.
source: pod reads made through the official RunPod MCP server during the runs and kept in the Claude Code session transcripts (not part of this repository); transcribed 2026-11-14, after every pod had been deleted (list-pods now returns no pods).
not_recorded: host CPU make and model, CPU cache sizes, host kernel. The provider does not guarantee host specifications beyond the allocation.
